method: Twenty deterministic numeric polygon-set differences. Original Google v3 full-precision WKT minus relevant accepted roofed-body plan controls; perimeter/site rings excluded. Source and masks all retained. No image pixels and no accepted-mesh review or generation.

models.interpretation: Exact source-set difference against accepted roofed-body plans; not proof that every sliver is a physical annex. Full original source retained; no old frame/field/floor/geometry or QA changed. Distinguish broad supported remainder from small competing boundary strips before authoring.

siteBoundaryControl.interpretation: Complete original numerical roof estimate predominantly within generalized named prison setting. The southwest boundary body crosses the approximate perimeter; whole original roof retained, exact ownership and membership unverified. No qualified2023relative height observation; original3.5m modeling height and5m allowance are not source observations. Exact roof membership, outline, facade, grade and2023continuity unverified. Below0.780tile ranking threshold; no per-building precision probability. No yard boundary adopted as roof.
